title: 第328章 对决第330章 诛神殿发生变故
slug: 黑化后我称霸三千大世界
lines: 杀！
被迷失了心智的屠古疯狂的朝着周围人杀去，此时的屠古早已不再是清醒的时候，而是一个只会杀戮的诡异生物
屠古浑身上下都散发出一股阴寒且邪恶的气息，令方圆几十里都变的暗淡无光
“快镇住殿主！”
九离玲珑阵！
话落，身为诛神殿大长老的李狂率先来到屠古的上空，双手迅速结阵印
八方七窍玲珑以八荒之势相互连接，并形成一座牢笼将屠古困在其中
杀！
被困在其中的屠古不断的攻击九离玲珑阵，并且所散发出来的气息让阵法外面的周围长老都感到胆寒
“老二老三快出手！”
见屠古身上的诡异气息越来越浓厚，同时屠古的势力也在诡异气息逐渐变的浓厚的同时也更加强大
不过是短短几秒的时间，屠古的实力就达到了巅峰
话落，诛神殿二长老，三长老纷纷来到上下一处，并以叠加的方式加固九离玲珑阵
杀，杀，杀！
屠古眼见困住自己的阵法越来越坚固，这令他感到更加愤怒
于是屠古的目光放在二长老朱景的身上，在三人当中他察觉的出只有他所设下的九离玲珑阵更弱
所以屠古就以朱景为突破口，并朝着朱景杀去
“不好，他朝着老二杀去了，转移核心力量到老二的所在阵法处”
李狂见状立马就让老三将三分之二的力量转移到朱景所镇守的一方
碰！
下一刻屠古的攻击瞬间就被抵挡了回去，这令屠古眼中的怒意更加暴躁
杀，杀，杀！
接着屠古的身影就化为八道，每一道身影都有他七分实力
杀！
随即屠古的八道身影就朝着周围攻杀
“该死的，这是要让我们无法集中镇压”
李狂看着突然就化为数道身影的屠古，顿时就明白他这是让他们无法集中到一起，并以此来破阵
“老二，不管你付出任何代价都不能让殿主从你那边突破！”
接着李狂就朝着朱景道，在三人当中老二是主修杀伐一道，对于阵法的运用并没有他和老三运用的好
“老三，你再添加一道星辰大阵来稳固九离玲珑阵”
收到李狂的指令后，老三郑开单手结印，以他为中心处立马就出现了星辰彼岸的情景
同时一道道来自星空的星辰之力开始朝着九离玲珑阵输入
“很好”
李狂见状心中顿时松了一口气，星辰之力可以镇压屠古本源中的诡异气息，而九离玲珑则是镇压屠古本身
呼！
当三人都松口气的时候，屠古就没有了动作
整个人安静的屹立在阵法的中央，而这让三人都感到不解
content_en:
kill!
Tu Gu, who had lost his mind, was killing the people around him crazily. At this time, Tu Gu was no longer awake, but a strange creature that could only kill.
Tu Gu's whole body exuded a cold and evil aura, making everything within a radius of dozens of miles dim.
"Quickly restrain the palace master!"
Nine Li Exquisite Formation!
As soon as he finished speaking, Li Kuang, the great elder of the Temple of Punishment, took the lead in coming to the sky above Tu Gu and quickly formed formation seals with his hands.
The seven exquisite orifices in all directions are connected to each other in the manner of the Eight Desolations, and form a cage to trap Tu Gu in it.
Kill!
Tu Gu, who was trapped in it, kept attacking the Nine Li Exquisite Formation, and the aura it exuded made the surrounding elders outside the formation feel frightened.
"Second and Third Lao, take action quickly!"
Seeing that the strange aura on Tu Gu's body is getting stronger and stronger, at the same time, Tu Gu's power is getting stronger as the weird aura gradually becomes stronger.
In just a few seconds, Tu Gu's strength reached its peak.
"Town!"
After saying this, the second elder and the third elder of the Temple of Punishment came to the upper and lower places one after another, and reinforced the Nine Li Exquisite Formation in a superimposed manner.
Kill, kill, kill!
Tu Gu saw that the formation that trapped him was getting stronger and stronger, which made him feel even more angry.
So Tu Gu focused his attention on the second elder Zhu Jing. Among the three of them, he noticed that only the Nine-Li Exquisite Formation he had set up was weaker.
So Tu Gu used Zhu Jing as a breakthrough point and killed Zhu Jing.
"No, he went towards the second child and transferred his core power to the formation where the second child was."
Upon seeing this, Li Kuang immediately asked Lao San to transfer two-thirds of his power to the side guarded by Zhu Jing.
Touch!
The next moment, Tu Gu's attack was instantly blocked, which made the anger in Tu Gu's eyes even more violent.
Kill, kill, kill!
Then Tu Gu's figure turned into eight figures, each figure possessing seven percent of his strength.
Kill!
Immediately, Tu Gu's eight figures attacked the surroundings.
"Damn, this is to prevent us from concentrating on suppression."
Li Kuang looked at Tu Gu who suddenly turned into several figures, and immediately understood that he was trying to prevent them from gathering together and use this to break the formation.
"Second brother, no matter what price you pay, you can't let the palace master break through from your side!"
Then Li Kuang walked towards Zhu Jingdao. Among the three of them, the second one majored in killing, and his use of formations was not as good as that of him and the third one.
"Lao San, you can add another star formation to stabilize the Nine Li Exquisite Formation."
"Yes"
After receiving Li Kuang's instructions, the third child, Zheng Kai, formed a seal with one hand. With him as the center, a scene on the other side of the stars immediately appeared.
At the same time, the power of stars from the starry sky began to be input towards the Nine Li Exquisite Array.
“Very good”
Li Kuang was relieved when he saw this. The power of the stars could suppress the strange aura in Tu Gu's origin, while the Nine Li Linglong could suppress Tu Gu himself.
Phew!
When the three of them breathed a sigh of relief, Tu Gu stopped moving.
The whole person stood quietly in the center of the formation, which made the three of them feel puzzled.
